verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server whose tools let AI agents call the Stripe API and search Stripe's docs and support articles, so an agent can connect officially to the platform Terminal is part of. However, nothing in the evidence shows the MCP server exposes Terminal-specific operations such as readers, locations, or in-person payment intents. Missing for 10: documented Terminal-specific MCP tools, a setup or auth walkthrough for connecting an agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use with Terminal.
